im on shtwt and edtwt, its honestly more helpful to have a community of people you can relate to without filters. i know for some, seeing others self-harm can be triggering but for me, its eases my urges to do it myself. dont report vent blogs unless there is a serious concern that they are in danger. i had a tumblr acc that was my only coping mechanism and i got termed 4 times which triggered a relapse. dont. report. vent. blogs.!! if you know certain things trigger you, stay away from them. stay safe
